adjustSkillPointsPerLevel.description: Adjust skill points gained per level

adjustSkillPointsPerRoot.description: Adjust skill points by factor from killing Root/Elixir Wells. original * factor

enableCreativeMode.description: Unlock most recipes, no crafting cost. Set includeUpgrade to also apply to Flame Altar upgrade recipes (e.g. Flame_Level_X_to_Y_Unlock).

adjustSlotCount.description: Storage slots - factor * original, cap at cap. Need rebuild storage

enableHigherBackpackSlot.description: Add slots to backpack size. Final size is original + bonus, capped at cap.

adjustAltarLimit.description: Altar count per flame level - multiply by factor, cap at cap. Experimental unlockSafeAltarCap attempts to bypass Flame Altar placement cap; may cause server, magic chest, or network bugs above 10 altars.

adjustTerrainExchange.description: Resource from terrain mining — original ÷ factor

adjustFactoryInventoryAccess.description: Normale Kisten und Stationsinventare als zusätzlichen Herstellungsbestand kennzeichnen.

enableAllMarkerFastTravel.description: Make most map markers fast travel-able

unblockBuildLimit.description: Remove build limit, place altars anywhere

adjustShroudSettings.description: Shroud fog settings — extinction (light penetration, 0-1, default 0.35), density (thickness, 0-1, default 1.0), barrier thickness (0 removes barrier, default 8)

enableSingleStepTaming.description: Benötigte erfolgreiche Zähmungsschritte unterstützter Tiere auf 1 setzen.

adjustAnimalProduction.description: Menge und Produktionsgeschwindigkeit unterstützter gezähmter Nutztiere anpassen.

adjustSummonedCompanions.description: Lokale Testfunktion für Grundlimit, Dauer, Stärke und Skelettvariante im Singleplayer oder auf einem Dedicated Server.

enableSkeletonSummoningSpells.description: Six named companion spells; matching server and all client patches required; multiplayer test pending.

adjustFallDistance.description: Fall distance: lethalDistance * factorLethal, startDistance * factorStart

enableUncapDedicatedServerSettings.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Extend numeric factor bounds only (0.1–5x); durations, enums, and booleans remain unchanged.

enableUncapClientSettings.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Extend numeric factor sliders only; booleans, enums, and time settings are skipped. Player health, stamina, and mana stay capped at 4x.

adjustMusicTime.description: Music time to max buff = original * factorTime

adjustMusicInstruments.description: Max instruments for comfort = original * factorInstruments

adjustMusicBuff.description: Max music comfort buff = original * factorBuff

adjustGemSlotProbability.description: Probability item has gem slot by rarity (value 0 - 1)

adjustWaterSourcePerFlameLevel.description: Water sources per flame level - multiply by factor, cap at cap

enableCraftOutputMultiplier.description: Craft output stack multiplier for every recipe

enableGatherLootMultipliers.description: Gather, enemy, and chest loot quantity multipliers

enableAutoLoot.description: Automatically collect supported ground loot and optionally settle gather-node drops

enableSourceLootSlots.description: Studio: random loot slot multipliers by source; not guaranteed item amounts.
